components.text:
Circle: large circle, ritual chalk.

A witch-type performer brings the one skill the one on the circle has chosen to mastery, on the night of a lunar eclipse. This one masters Ultimate skills.
Choose the skill on the Skills page of the hub. The rite is refused, and nothing is taken, if anything forbids the skill from being mastered.
By default costs 2,000,000 base Max EP, spent once it is mastered, 5 nether stars, 5 dragon's breath and 10 netherite ingots. One rite per player every 7 days.
